recommendation: Keep the core audit commit as-is. issue_request: FHIR-17912 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for the core rendering-styleSensitive extension. It asked to restrict the extension context to Resource, update the definition/comment so unsupported style/markdown/xhtml rendering prevents appropriate rendering of the resource, add SDC-specific usage guidance, ensure SDC ValueSet and CodeSystem profile usage, and add related SDC/ValueSet expansion guidance.
initial_application: Historical core commit f7bcd0a0a8dda76fc89e07041ba4cae3b0e38c83, merged by 0cdfeece691a6aa51e2cc015664e5230a9c534bd, applied GF#17912 by changing the rendering extensions spreadsheet to context Resource and replacing the styleSensitive definition/comment with the approved resource-wide rendering guidance.
additional_context: R5 history records that all extensions moved to the hl7.fhir.uv.extensions package, and the current core checkout now only has the rendering-styleSensitive OID rather than an active StructureDefinition source row. The active Extension Pack definition retains the updated definition/comment and SDC link but declares context element/Element. R4/R4B generated history also shows element/Element, and a 2019 Questionnaire Zulip thread called that broad context wrong and suggested Resource/root Questionnaire scope. Later SDC issues FHIR-42990 and FHIR-50602 deprecated/replaced SDC use of rendering-styleSensitive, but those SDC decisions do not move the source back into core.
reconciliation: No core source file was changed. The required core result is an empty audit commit documenting that a remaining source correction, if still desired after later SDC deprecation work, belongs in the FHIR Extension Pack definition rather than this core branch.
